title: Networking
examples: How do I prepare for an informational interview?
What questions should I ask someone in a field I am interested in?
Is it okay to ask for a job during an informational interview?

explain.say: Today we are learning about informational interviews for career exploration.

items: Goal: To learn about a career path.
Not: To ask for a job directly.
Prep: Research the person and industry.

explain.say: First, you need to identify a specific role or industry you are curious about.
Next, you should find someone who currently works in that role or industry.
When you set up the meeting, always be respectful of their limited time.
During the interview, focus on asking open-ended questions about their day-to-day work.

items: What does a typical day look like?
What skills are most valuable now?
What was your career path like?

explain.say: For a real-life example, imagine you are interested in data science.

faq.q: Should I ask them for a job during the interview?
faq.a: No, you should not ask for a job directly. The goal is information gathering, not job application. You can ask if they know of any entry-level roles or connections.
asks: Can I use this to get a job?
Is it okay to ask for a referral?

faq.q: How long should I schedule the interview for?
faq.a: Keep it concise, usually twenty to thirty minutes is plenty of time. Respecting their time shows professionalism and consideration.
asks: How much time should I book?

faq.q: What if I don't know who to ask?
faq.a: If you are unsure, start by talking to someone in a related field or a university alumni network. They can guide you to the right people.
asks: Who should I talk to first?

faq.q: What should I bring with me to the interview?
faq.a: Bring a notebook and a pen to take notes. This shows you are actively listening and valuing their advice. Always bring a few prepared questions.

faq.q: What should I do after the interview?
faq.a: Always send a thoughtful thank-you email within twenty-four hours. Reference something specific you learned to show you paid attention.
asks: Do I need to send a follow-up?
What makes a good thank-you note?

facts: The primary purpose is gathering knowledge, not seeking employment.
Always prepare specific, thoughtful questions beforehand.
A follow-up thank-you note is considered professional etiquette.
Informational interviews can be conducted virtually or in person.

quiz.say: What is the main goal of an informational interview?
quiz.show: A) To secure a job offer.

options.show: D) To network with many people.
options.say: D) To network with many people.

options.show: B) To learn about a career path.
options.say: B) To learn about a career path.

options.show: A) To secure a job offer.
options.say: A) To secure a job offer.

quiz.why: The focus remains on gathering knowledge, not job hunting.

wrong.0: Focusing on depth with one person is better than breadth.
wrong.2: This puts too much pressure on the conversation.
wrong.3: While helpful, this is not the main objective.

quiz.say: If you are preparing for an interview about graphic design, what is a good question to ask?
quiz.show: A) How much do you make?

options.show: C) What skills do you use daily?
options.say: C) What skills do you use daily?

options.show: A) How much do you make?
options.say: A) How much do you make?

options.show: B) Can you give me a job?
options.say: B) Can you give me a job?

options.show: D) What is the history of design?
options.say: D) What is the history of design?

quiz.why: This question prompts them to describe their actual work process.

wrong.1: This question is too direct about money.
wrong.2: This violates the rule of not asking for work.
wrong.3: This is too academic and not career-focused.

quiz.say: After the interview, what is the most important follow-up action?

options.show: C) Asking for five more contacts.
options.say: C) Asking for five more contacts.

options.show: D) Waiting until next week to reply.
options.say: D) Waiting until next week to reply.

options.show: B) Sending a thank-you note within twenty-four hours.
options.say: B) Sending a thank-you note within twenty-four hours.

quiz.why: A timely thank-you note solidifies the positive connection.

wrong.0: This is premature and ignores the informational nature.
wrong.1: This can seem overwhelming and demanding.
wrong.2: Delaying the thank you note makes a poor final impression.
